universe.market: TWSE-listed four-digit common stocks (MI_INDEX closing table)
universe.tpex: excluded this round (no certified TPEx source); Owner decision
universe.prices: raw prices (price return); ex-rights days are flagged, not adjusted

population_rule: complete case: a row enters training, validation, test and inference only if every model feature is non-null

zscore.population: all complete-case rows of the same session (not narrowed by strategy rules)
zscore.formula: (x - mean) / std over that session (ddof=0), std = 0 -> 0
zscore.nan_handling: rows with NaN features are not in the population and are never filled

feature_window: 150 calendar days ending at the session, computed by build_feature_history exactly as in recovered Daily

rsi_z.null_rule: NaN until the indicator window is filled

bias_z.null_rule: NaN when ma20 is NaN or 0

macd_hist_z.null_rule: NaN until the window is filled

kd_k_z.null_rule: NaN until the window is filled

bb_width_z.null_rule: NaN until the window is filled

volume_ratio_z.formula: volume.replace(0, 1) / mean of the last 20 volumes, clip 0..5

natr_z.null_rule: NaN until the window is filled

std_20_z.null_rule: NaN until the window is filled

foreign_ratio_z.source: T86 foreign (ex foreign dealers) / MI_INDEX volume
foreign_ratio_z.null_rule: NaN when the stock is absent from T86

foreign_consec_days_z.formula: consecutive sessions with foreign_buy > 0 over the stock history

trust_consec_days_z.formula: consecutive sessions with trust_buy > 0 over the stock history

dealer_consec_days_z.formula: consecutive sessions with dealer_buy > 0 over the stock history
dealer_consec_days_z.excluded_reason: CODE FIX REQUIRED FIRST: the shared core derives it from the one-day cross-section (always 0 or 1)

institutional_net_buy_z.null_rule: NaN if any component is NaN

institutional_consec_buy_days_z.formula: foreign + trust + dealer consecutive days, 0 when net buy <= 0
institutional_consec_buy_days_z.null_rule: NaN if any component is NaN
institutional_consec_buy_days_z.excluded_reason: CODE FIX REQUIRED FIRST: depends on dealer_consec_days

chip_score_z.null_rule: NaN if any component is NaN (no neutral 50)

news_sentiment_score_z.formula: one market-wide sentiment code per session
news_sentiment_score_z.excluded_reason: constant across stocks within a session: z-score is 0, no cross-sectional information, no historical record

revenue_yoy_z.excluded_reason: no official publication time (statutory-deadline estimate only); revisit when a timestamp source exists (OD-12)

rd_ratio_z.null_rule: NaN when the latest filing has no actual publication date
rd_ratio_z.excluded_reason: publication dates exist only to FY2025; FY2026 filings are deadline estimates

label.definition: 1 if max(high over the next N official sessions) / close - 1 > target_return else 0

hyperparameters.scale_pos_weight: (negatives / positives) * 0.5 on the training segment only
hyperparameters.tuning: none (same values as jobs/train_model.py); validation is used for acceptance only, not early stopping

acceptance.population: complete-case rows of the segment (all TWSE-listed common stocks); every metric is per session, then averaged over the segment

top_decile_lift_mean.definition: precision of label = 1 among the top 10 % by score in a session / that session base rate

monthly_lift_positive_share.definition: share of calendar months whose mean top-decile lift is above 1.0

pooled_roc_auc.definition: ROC AUC of the score against the label over the whole segment

mean_rank_ic.definition: mean per-session Spearman correlation of score and realised future max return

guards: label horizon of every training row ends before the next segment starts (purge check)
features at session t are identical when all data after t is removed (future-independence check)
AUC with permuted labels lies within 0.48..0.52
no session belongs to two segments
model feature list equals this specification
data manifest SHA-256 equals the registered one
acceptance.status: PROPOSED thresholds; frozen only by the SHA-256 of the owner-approved version
acceptance.on_failure: the model is rejected; no tuning on validation or test; a new model needs a new specification version

training_period.data_end: last session certified in the frozen data manifest

versioning.old_models: kept unchanged beside the new files until certification

inference_contract.features: build_feature_history + build_multi_factor_matrix, order and names equal to the model feature list
inference_contract.zscore_population: all complete-case rows of the session
inference_contract.missing: rows with a missing model input are excluded, never filled; no valid model -> no published ranking
inference_contract.model_gate: training_data_end and spec sha256 present, window start after training_data_end
